question: Do pilot-selected projection differences persist on fresh larger curves, can a cheap public-input stochastic ladder model orient a target, and what exactly prevents local matchgate basis changes?
relation_to_pilot: Fresh targeted follow-up to EXP-ECDLP-fe3337. Features selected from earlier observations; no claim this is the original 192-target 12/14/16/18-bit solver study or that the pilot was exhaustive algorithm research.

cohort.freshness: Reject identical pilot (p,a,b); complete candidate history retained; sampler not uniform over isomorphism classes
cohort.target_sampling: Independent custodian C++mt19937_64 from OS random_device; iid uniform scalars with replacement. Seeds/labels withheld from candidate inputs until outputs sealed.
cohort.unit_of_replication: registered curve; shared targets/features/modes are paired, not independent curves

projection_scale.analytic_control_reuse: Only proved constant/full-point or Kummer codomain-relabeling invariants; derived flags and zero skipped visit counters explicit, independently calibrated at small sizes
projection_scale.inference: Exact finite populations; null MonteCarlo spread reported; no post-hoc inferential or attack claim

decoder.public_kernel: K_b(a,c)=Pr(phi(2X+bP)=c|phi(X)=a), b=0,1, fitted from uniform unlabelled subgroup samples
decoder.sampler: Tonelli-Shanks random x/root, half accept y=0, include identity with probability1/N, then[h] with gcd(h,r)=1; no ordered orbit/scalar table
decoder.canonical_range: MSB backward DP over k<=r-1 with lex-less state; no repeated representatives
decoder.random_offset: Start each view at public R; terminal observation phi(Q+[2^ell]R). Each true prefix marginal is uniform, not a proof of conditional Markov histories.
decoder.model_prefix: Forward alpha propagated through learned K
decoder.exact_prefix: Compute actual public prefix EC state from R/P and known prefix bits, project it and consult the same suffix beta
decoder.multiview_score: sum_i log(dot(alpha_i,beta_i))-(m-1)log(n_completions); exact mode substitutes one-hot actual projected prefix. Product-of-means approximation, not exact multiview suffix marginal.
decoder.costs: Training, calibration, sampling/square roots, DP, offset states, beam work, all candidate EC checks and model storage retained. Model reuse count and cold/warm scopes explicit; no wall-time advantage inference.
calibrations: exact range-DP vs finite exhaustive reference
full-state scalar-labelled toy positive controls, not EC inputs
constant model and exact prefix candidate sets identical; exact B/r chance under independent uniform targets
one-step heldout logloss and accuracy vs marginal-only model
Dobrushin delta0/1 and powers, floating diagnostic only
decoder.acceptance: Every proposed candidate checked against full public[k]P=Q; independent Jacobian checker repeats the equation. Positive toy witnesses can occur by chance and do not establish a competitive algorithm.
decoder.blindness: Source-enforced public-input interface; no OS-isolation or formal blind-solver claim

basis_audit.rational_grammar: All625matrices with entries[-2,2]; det!=0 candidate filter; preserve every admissible arm
basis_audit.field_pin_obstruction: Single common invertibleM, both unabsorbed CONST0/CONST1 parity-pure impliesMmonomial; mixed-parity AND remains mixed
basis_audit.characteristic_two_object: Fixed isolated three-leg AND tensor; independent invertible2x2 leg gauges overcommutative char2 ring
basis_audit.covariance_certificate: B((A tensor B tensor C)f)=detA detB detC B(f), exact ordinary F2 polynomial normalization in20indeterminates without x^2=x quotient
scope_controls: AND as sumof2parity-pure signatures disproves closure under arbitrary sums
basis_audit.limits: No claim about block grouping, internal-wire elimination, per-wire rational pin absorption, arbitrary tensor algorithms, ECDLP lower bounds, or published novelty; no Lean proof claimed

execution.shard_rule: Public-size LPT weights declared infixture-shards.json; disjoint union24
execution.watchdog_scope: host/process protection, not a research spending cap or mathematical falsification

completion: Collect every frozen case/control/NA/null outcome with valid source/input bindings, genuine preapproval/selector/liveclaim/supervisor, independently checked toy witnesses, complete lossless archives and descriptive inspected report.
failure_classes: wrong output or failed control invalidates affected measurement
model or bounded grammar failure is scope-limited
no positive result does not prove all classical attacks impossible

No full solver advantage without matched strong baseline and full-cost independent evidence
HMM/beam/BP is established prior art and the closest lead already contains stochastic double-and-add propagation
